prototype_notice: Procedural prototype, not finished anime; abstract ridges, one silhouetted traveler, moon and sparse particles only.

scenes.motif: Abstract moonlit ridges in desaturated blue-gray and charcoal; one small stationary silhouetted traveler below center, sparse particles as faint traces of the past, dim pearl moon. Low-contrast muted bands keep the prototype landscape subdued; refined figure contour and terrain articulation remain a renderer capability gap, not claimed as solved.
scenes.camera: Wide landscape with broad negative space above the small traveler and moon offset from the figure; restrained lateral drift as a slight whole-frame crop with slow horizontal pan, traveler stationary.

scenes.motif: Same abstract ridges and stationary traveler suffused with dim faded amber, suggesting an indistinct recollection within the blue-gray landscape; sparse abstract particles only, no literal memory imagery. Warmth kept muted and integrated; prototype figure and terrain forms retained.
scenes.camera: Slightly closer whole-frame framing with a gentle inward move; traveler remains small and grounded, moon held as a stable anchor.

scenes.motif: Recollection withdraws into slate and muted indigo ridges with only a faint trace of amber in the glow; particles thinned, traveler held small in spacious quiet as weariness returns. Cool subdued bands reduce streak contrast; prototype forms retained.
scenes.camera: Return toward the opening spacious wide framing at the same traveler position; whole-frame zoom eases outward and settles to rest.

scenes.motif: Weaker echo of recollection: faint dusty amber returns within charcoal and blue ridges, abstract particles only, no dramatic reveal or literal memory imagery; traveler small, isolated and stationary in generous darkness. Dusty glow kept close to ground tones; prototype limitation remains visible.
scenes.camera: Wide landscape preserving generous negative space around the isolated traveler; restrained slow whole-frame drift with no abrupt change.

scenes.motif: Warmth recedes into muted blue-gray with a residual warm tint in moon and glow; abstract ridges and small stationary traveler persist quietly beneath the moon, particles visually quieter, ending in subdued visibility without triumphant resolution. Prototype silhouette and ridges retained.
scenes.camera: Balanced wide view with the small traveler beneath the moon and readable ridge contours; whole-frame movement eases and settles to near stillness.
